name: Shenzhen Hello Tech Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Hello Tech Energy Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, branding, sales, and service of lithium battery energy storage products and photovoltaic products in China, North America, the rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers solar generators under the Jackery brand; portable energy storage products; portable energy storage products with optical charging; outdoor solar panels; courtyard balcony light storage; fixed home energy storage systems; and residential photovoltaic products.
